title: Template or dependency bloat in build-critical paths
summary: Heavy template instantiation or broad dependencies causing excessive compile time and binary growth.
rationale: Build waste consumes developer time, CI compute, and energy long before production runtime.

detection.notes: Look for large header-only dependencies, repeated template instantiations, or broad includes in common headers.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use forward declarations, precompiled headers judiciously, explicit instantiation, smaller includes, and dependency hygiene.
remediation.tradeoffs: Compile-time optimization must not undermine type safety or maintainability.
